title: System Architecture Overview
content: Our system uses microservices architecture with event-driven patterns. We use Kubernetes for orchestration and PostgreSQL for primary data storage. Key principles: loose coupling, high cohesion, and clear service boundaries.

title: Engineering Best Practices
content: Code review is mandatory for all changes. We use trunk-based development with feature flags. Testing pyramid: unit tests for logic, integration tests for APIs, E2E for critical paths.

title: Employee Compensation Guidelines
content: Salary bands are reviewed quarterly. Performance reviews happen bi-annually. Benefits include health insurance, 401k matching, and unlimited PTO.
